Super mode: the green look (R845, for R811 and R850)

One green per column, all on OKLCH hue 130° (R850 keeps the hue and moves the lightness per theme, as R154's ring). Every value shown meets its floor: a green legend ≥ 4.5:1 (≥ 7:1 in High contrast) on every key ground it sits on, a ring or glow ≥ 3:1, the label on a green fill the same as a legend. The colour-vision distances (app/scripts/cvd.ts, the smallest of normal vision and the three deficiencies) are aimed at theme-gen's Shift-to-Alpha floor (0.12; 0.10 in High contrast); below marks where no green reaches it. The numbers are node tools/probes/super-mode.ts.

The sign: two candidates (Shift and Fmt at rest)

⇧
shift
⇟
⇟
Fmt

⇟ (U+21DF: a flick down, a page's jump)

⇧
shift
▣
▣
Fmt

▣ (U+25A3: a block)

What each state means

  • At rest: super mode is off; only its sign shows, on Shift's bottom-left corner (Shift's flick down) and as Fmt's Shift legend (Shift + Fmt).
  • One action (a flick down on Shift): the next key with a super job does it and the mode ends. Lit: ◀ ▶ (a green ring and a soft glow: the next or previous block), ⌫ (deletes the block left of the caret), U1–U6 (open the key's setup), Fmt's sign. ▲ ▼ fade: they have no super job. Every other key looks as at rest and does nothing while the mode is on.
  • Held (Shift + Fmt): the same keys lit, Shift filled green; the mode stays until an exit.
  • Held, Shift pressed: a lone Shift does not end the mode, it arms the chord: only Fmt's sign is lit.
  • The exits: Esc, or Shift + Fmt again. In one action, the key that does its job ends it too.
  • Orange stays Shift's: the green is super mode's only colour; Shift's legends, ring and fill keep their orange (R729), Alpha its teal.
  • The sign: two candidates under each column, ⇟ and ▣; the keypads above draw ⇟. The owner picks one.
